entries.purpose: Tell the Commander who the active agent is: name, id, class/role, level, model, and its placed capabilities.
entries.promise: Typing /whoami prints the real active agent identity (name+id from the roster, class from Specialties/role, level from Xp.compute, model+provider from Harness, placed caps from World.heroCaps) — every field read from live state, none invented.

coverage.ref: scripts/qa/journeys.mjs (J7 slash-truth: bare "/whoami" typed into the real #chat-input dispatches to a local .cmsg.agent line, no slash user row)

entries.name: /yolo — toggle full-access approval mode
entries.purpose: Toggle the active agent's approval mode between full-access (no consent prompts) and ask-first, as a per-agent roster property.
entries.promise: Typing /yolo flips (or sets, with on|off) agent.approvalMode via App.applyConfig({approvalMode}) and confirms the real new mode; it is a per-agent setting, not per-chat.

coverage.ref: test/slash.test.js (yolo in catalog; dispatch carries args)
